rationale: Attempted to execute the registered discriminator for @q_snapshot_delta_underflow by driving a real single-node cluster (TrailingLogs=0, a high SnapshotThreshold, and a user Snapshot()) until compaction empties the log store while the snapshot index stays high, then comparing shouldSnapshot() before and after. The harness did not run in the local fixed-input workspace (it failed immediately), so I am not submitting it as an experiment and make no measured claim: the source-only interpretation of that question stands unchanged and its limitation that the emptied-store state is unobserved still applies. No new defect judgment is recorded this turn; the next step is to repair the harness (most likely the cluster configuration or the internal accessor used) and re-submit the same discriminator.
